body.x: PHIATON(www.phiaton.com) presented noise cancelling technology bluetooth headphone ‘CHORD MS 530’ at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Chord MS 530 with superior sound quality features Bluetooth 4.0 and active noise cancelling technology. In all genres of music, whether it is pop, rock, jazz, or classical, the perfect combination of chords bring melody to a song. The Chord MS 530 also has the exellent combination of cutting edge technology, unique design, and exceptional sound quality to bring harmony to your ears.
Multipoint connection connects two devices at the same time. Two bluetooth enabled devices can be used simultaneously, such as smartphone and tablet PC or smartphone and MP3 player.

Phiaton’s 40mm Titanium Driver Technology provides amazing sound reproduction. By adding a coat of titanium to the driver unit, the sound quality is enhanced, with deep rich bass and added sonic presence.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
